steps.journal: Speak with Merchant Yulia.
steps.says: Here you are.

steps.journal: Take the ant leg segments from the ants outside the walls.
Bring the silk cord, the plain robe and the ant leg segments to Nefar.
steps.says: Everything I need. Here is your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/freeport/wizard.json, # Level 4 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's purchase is a hand-over here: the merchant gives the item when spoken to.

quests.name: The Highwaymen
quests.offer: Highwaymen rob the caravans coming into Freeport. Leave by the blacksmith, follow the road north, then turn right to a grassy hill with a druid stone. Kill them and bring back the stolen goods.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Take the stolen goods from the highwaymen on the hill with the druid stone.
Bring the stolen goods to Nefar.
steps.says: The goods are back where they belong. Well done.

quests.name: Trouble in Temby
quests.offer: Thieves broke into the library and stole an ancient rune stone. Bandelan, a smuggler in Temby, has it. Secure the stone.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Take the rune stone of ghizsa from Bandelan in Temby.
Bring the rune stone of ghizsa to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: Exactly what I wanted. Take this.

quests.name: The Novandear Gang
quests.offer: The Novandear gang comes out at night by the broken bridge north of Freeport. Yilinaka Novandear stole plans from the library: kill her and bring them back. Then buy lantern oil from Merchant Landi.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Take the stolen plans from Yilinaka Novandear at the broken bridge north of Freeport.
Bring the stolen plans to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: Good. Now the lantern oil.

steps.journal: Buy lantern oil from Merchant Landi.
steps.says: Lantern oil. Mind the flame.

steps.journal: Bring the lantern oil to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: You have done well. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/freeport/wizard.json, # Level 10 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Yilinyaka Novandear is the Yilinaka Novandear of this server.

quests.name: The Note for Duminven
quests.offer: Take this bag of coins to Agent Wilkenson at the docks. He will give you a note for Duminven in Saerk's Tower; do as Duminven says.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Bring the bag of coins to Agent Wilkenson.
steps.says: The coins. Take this note to Duminven in Saerk's Tower.

steps.journal: Bring the note from wilkinson to Duminven.
steps.says: A thief named Eliene is in Bastable. Follow her, kill her and her contact, then come back.

steps.journal: Slay Eliene.
Slay her contact, Grave Robber Laen.
Speak with Duminven.
steps.says: Done. Take this mark back to your master.

steps.journal: Bring the mark of louhmanta to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: The mark. You have served well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/freeport/wizard.json, # Level 13 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Eliene's contact is Grave Robber Laen, the grave robber the guides put under a bridge in Bastable.

quests.name: Poacher's Leggings
quests.offer: Tailor Weynia on the island by the lighthouse south of Freeport can make you fine leggings. Gather what she asks for and bring the leggings back to me.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Tailor Weynia.
steps.says: Bring me a sidewinder's skin, a sand skipper's carapace, Gargantula's silk and vulture feathers from Dteven Savis.

steps.journal: Take the sidewinder skin from the sidewinders in the hills west of Weynia.
Take the sand skipper carapace from the sand skippers on the southern beach.
Take the bundle of pristine silk from Gargantula in the western ruins.
Buy vulture feathers from Dteven Savis by the west gate.
steps.says: The best feathers in Freeport. Mind them.

steps.journal: Bring the sidewinder skin, the sand skipper carapace, the bundle of pristine silk and the vulture feathers to Tailor Weynia.
steps.says: All of it! Here are your poacher's leggings.

steps.journal: Bring the poacher's leggings to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: Fine work. Let me finish them for you.

quests.name: The Real Mark
quests.offer: The mark you brought me is a fake. Find the real one. Agent Wilkenson at the docks may know where it went.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Agent Wilkenson.
steps.says: The real mark? Ask Madame Telina, just east of here.

steps.journal: Speak with Telina the Dark Witch.
steps.says: A troll has it: Roj Eir Sew' Eil, a nasehir cutthroat in the second camp south-west of the docks.

steps.journal: Take the mark of louoth from Roj Eir Sew' Eil at the nasehir camp.
Bring the mark of louoth to Telina the Dark Witch.
steps.says: Now the pirates' treasure: search the sand-covered chests on the skeletons' island off Muniel's Tea Garden.

steps.journal: Take the chiseled great axe of doom from the sand-covered chests on the skeleton pirates' island.
Bring the chiseled great axe of doom to Telina the Dark Witch.
steps.says: One more: the waterlogged chest by the obelisk under Razor Back Fang.

steps.journal: Take the etched helmet of greatness from the waterlogged chest in the pool under Razor Back Fang.
Bring the etched helmet of greatness to Telina the Dark Witch.
steps.says: As I foresaw. Take this note to your master.

steps.journal: Bring the note from telina to Sivrendesh.
steps.says: The real mark is where it belongs. You have earned your path.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/freeport/wizard.json, # Level 20 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide offers a choice; this gives the first: Blazing Clash, or Mental Focus.
